name: monitor-root-cause-recall-reporter
description: Reads the managed monitors memory store (per-alarm recurring root-cause history), cross-checks it with live alarm state and the reflections store, and reports repeat-offender alarms clustering on a single fixable cause versus multi-cause chronic and stable alarms, prioritized for fix-at-the-source.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on MON at 08:30 UTC
